comment: WORST PROFESSOR IN THE DEPARTMENT. DOESN'T TEACH AT ALL, BUT EXPECTS YOU TO KNOW IT AND ACTS SHOCKED WHEN PPL FAIL... He got Hoyle to teach an entire section because he said he didn't know how to. Grading is ridiculous. He has his favorites. Class is pointless. Cancelled class once b/c he didn't know what he was doing, but still gave the assignment
doesn't really teach the material well, so you have to learn it yourself.  tests are a bit hard, but not impossible
Great teacher, he is helpful and makes acct interesting.  He is also fairly easy and if you do the work you can get an A.
good guy, interesting class but he's sidetracked really easily trying to be funny. i did learn a lot of accounting but his tests are very hard. NOT an easy A at all

Very nice guy with interesting stories. His new 'textbook' that he wrote himself, sometimes gets in the way of learning. He marks off for little things but a B- would be expected if you did your work. Very difficult to get an A

cool guy, terrible at explaining things.  class seems like a breeze until you get grades back and he punishes you for miniscule mistakes that dont matter.  doesnt tell you anything if you go to his office.  nice guy, pretty bad prof.

Sanborn is a unique guy.  He's fairly down to earth and classes are fairly interesting but there was definitely something missing.  I just didn't really know what was going on a lot of the time and had to read the book to really understand the material.  Had an A til the final, which sucked. Ended up with A-/B+ (?). try to take somebody else.

This guy is horrible, you can't read anything he writes on the board, he slurs his speach, and he isn't fair in his grading.  He might know accounting well, but he certainly can't teach it to you.  I can't believe he has tenure.  If you take this guy, plan on teaching yourself everything.    One plus: no attendance policy

Nice guy, but terrible teacher. He does not teach you anything in class but then expects you to know how to do it and makes his tests very confusing.  Gets pleasure out of seeing kids fail, he likes his class average to be around a B-  If you're interested in acct, do NOT take his class.
He's a great guy who really enjoys what he's doing. Very knowledgable about his subject; the class is somewhat difficult but he is very fair and easy to talk to.
He is an amazing teacher, makes class interesting and fun, coolest teacher ever, always helpful
